  • 5–8 years of experience in materials management, production planning/scheduling, and/or supply chain operations within manufacturing.
  • Experience with ERP/MRP systems such as Infor CSI, SAP, Oracle, or comparable platforms.
  • Experience with master production scheduling, material flow, inventory management, and critical supply issues.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to evaluate forecasts, inventory, lead times, capacity, and planning performance.
  • Strong Excel and Microsoft Office skills.
  • Ability to solve material shortages, scheduling conflicts, and competing priorities using data and sound judgment.
  • Strong communication, organization, attention to detail, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Operations Management, Engineering, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Ability to periodically work in warehouse and production environments and travel between sites as needed.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting ERP implementations, upgrades, or data conversions.
  • APICS/ASCM CPIM or CSCP certification.
  • Experience in a multi-site or matrixed organization.

Location: Rochester, NY. This role can be onsite or hybrid, offering flexibility while maintaining close connection to our manufacturing operations and cross-functional teams.

The hourly rate for this position is $40.00- $45.00. This range represents the Company’s good faith estimate of the base compensation for this role at the time of posting. Actual compensation will be determined based on several factors, including but not limited to relevant experience, skills, qualifications, internal equity, and geographic location. In addition to hourly rate, this role may be eligible for annual incentive compensation and/or long-term incentives, subject to Company plans. title: Graduate Software Engineer- Java
description:

Ben jij een Java-expert die houdt van complexe uitdagingen? Bouw mee aan innovatieve softwareoplossingen in een high performance team. Solliciteer nu als Java Developer en maak impact!

Van bedrijven binnen de overheid tot aan diverse zorginstellingen, hospitality bedrijven en de grotere banken, in deze functie komt het allemaal voorbij.

Daarnaast werk je in deze functie natuurlijk nauw samen met collega’s en klanten in multidisciplinaire teams. Hierbij zorg je ervoor dat applicaties voldoen aan de hoogste technische standaarden, en gebruik je jouw expertise in Java, Spring Boot en andere moderne frameworks om robuuste oplossingen te ontwikkelen. Naast het schrijven van code, denk je actief mee over nieuwe technologieën, verbeteringen in ontwikkelprocessen en ben je vanzelfsprekend dan ook betrokken bij de gehele levenscyclus van een project.

De regionale teams bestaan uit vooraanstaande experts die vooral jouw groei en kennisontwikkeling ondersteunen. Vanuit deze teams krijg je dagdagelijks te maken met diverse collega’s vanuit verschillende invalshoeken, van Software Development, tot aan Data&AI tot aan Hyperautomation, bij ilionx sta je er nooit helemaal alleen voor!

Of je nu op een van onze kantoren, bij de klant of thuis werkt, bij ilionx krijg je de perfecte omgeving om je passie voor data tot leven te brengen.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Incentive Offers
description:
Who we are

The real world is the next frontier, and at Metropolis, we are creating the artificial intelligence to make it responsive. We are pioneering the Recognition Economy — a future where mundane repetition disappears and being known unlocks access, comfort, and belonging everywhere you go. From transforming parking into a seamless drive-in, drive-out experience for millions of Members to expanding our intelligence layer across retail and hospitality, we are building a world that feels instinctive and magical. The future isn’t coming; it’s here, and we need builders, innovators, and problem solvers to help us create it.

Who you are

Metropolis is seeking a Senior Software Engineer to lead the design and implementation of our foundational incentive and rewards platform. In this role, you will act as a strong steward of our backend systems, building the core infrastructure that connects real-world vision signals with personalized member experiences. You are an expert-level engineer who can explain complex business and technical requirements, mentoring others while driving large-scope projects to completion. You thrive on high-growth challenges and are eager to build high-quality, scalable systems that bridge digital engagement with physical arrivals.

What you'll do

  • Design and implement the backend services that power the Metropolis incentive and rewards infrastructure
  • Build real-time event streaming architectures to process and react to high-frequency signals from the physical world
  • Develop scalable compliance and preference management services to ensure cross-vertical message delivery integrity
  • Architect intelligent decisioning frameworks that evaluate user context and profiles to deliver personalized experiences
  • Create robust service architectures to manage product eligibility, partner configurations, and budget constraints
  • Implement comprehensive attribution and measurement systems to quantify user engagement and campaign efficacy
  • Scale and maintain multi-modal identity systems that bridge digital tokens with real-world identifiers
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams in Product, Marketing, and Data to define the long-term technical roadmap
  • Mentor team members and lead technical discussions to drive continuous improvement of the engineering platform
  • Drive the full software development lifecycle from initial conceptualization through to production deployment

What we're looking for

  • 6+ years of software engineering experience
  • BS or MS in Computer Science or equivalent work experience
  • Working knowledge of Scala, Java, or other JVM languages supporting functional programming
  • Experience building distributed systems using microservices, SOA, and event-driven architectures
  • Deep understanding of agile processes and the software development life cycle, including TDD/BDD and CI/CD
  • Experience with database technologies such as MySQL and RDS
  • Proven ability to design and build highly available and scalable systems
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills for presenting complex technical information
  • Professional exposure to developing large-scale, high-quality systems for consumer-facing applications

While not required, these are a plus:

  • Hands-on experience with container technologies and infrastructure as code
  • Previous experience working in innovative, high-growth environments

Our Stack

  • Languages + Frameworks: TypeScript, React, Scala (principally), Java (limited)
  • Datastores: MySQL, PostgreSQL, Snowflake
  • Cloud: AWS
  • Version control: Git & GitHub
  • AI Tooling: Claude Code, Copilot on GitHub
  • Observability: Datadog

4 Days in Office: Metropolis values in-person collaboration to drive innovation, strengthen culture, and enhance the Member experience. Our corporate team members hold to our office-first model, which requires employees to be on-site at least four days a week, fostering organic interactions that spark creativity and connection

When you join Metropolis, you'll join a team of world-class product leaders and engineers, building an ecosystem of technologies at the intersection of parking, mobility, and real estate. Our goal is to build an inclusive culture where everyone has a voice and the best idea wins. You will play a key role in building and maintaining this culture as our organization grows. The anticipated base salary for this position is $177,000.00 USD to $216,000.00 USD annually. The actual base salary offered is determined by a number of variables, including, as appropriate, the applicant's qualifications for the position, years of relevant experience, distinctive skills, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and the location of residence and/or place of employment. Base salary is one component of Metropolis' total compensation package, which may also include access to or eligibility for healthcare benefits, a 401(k) plan, short-term and long-term disability coverage, basic life insurance, a lucrative stock option plan, bonus plans, and more. #LI-LR1 #LI-Onsite

title: Technical Lead
description:
Overview of role:

The Project/Program Tech Lead provides technical leadership on complex projects and programs. They make sure solutions are planned and delivered in line with enterprise standards, business goals, and operational needs. Working across delivery, architecture, engineering, product, vendor, and business teams, they turn program goals into clear technical direction, manage technical dependencies and risks, and guide teams through delivery. The role keeps work aligned, technically sound, and focused on outcomes from start-up through implementation and hand-off to operations.
Key deliverables / responsibilities include:

Technical Delivery Leadership: Lead the day-to-day technical work on assigned projects and programs, and make sure teams understand the solution direction, scope, constraints, and expected outcomes.
Solution Alignment: Work with Solution Architects, engineering, security, infrastructure, operations, product, and vendor teams to keep solutions in line with enterprise standards, target-state architecture, operational needs, and business priorities. The Solution Architect sets the solution direction, standards, patterns, and major trade-offs; the Tech Lead turns that direction into practical plans and coordinates delivery across teams.
Technical Planning: Break program goals into technical work packages, milestones, sequencing, and integration points. Support estimates, sprint or release planning, and roadmap alignment where needed.
Dependency and Risk Management: Track and manage technical dependencies, assumptions, risks, and decisions across teams. Raise issues early, and offer clear options, recommendations, and trade-offs so decisions can be made on time.
Execution Support: Guide teams through design, build, test, implementation, cutover, stabilization, and hand-off to operations. Make sure teams are technically ready for key milestones, and lead end-to-end technical triage when work is off plan or issues arise.
Governance and Decision Support: Prepare for and take part in architecture, technical, security, operational, and delivery reviews. Keep clear records of technical decisions and share them with the teams they affect.
Stakeholder Communication: Explain technical topics in clear, plain terms for delivery teams, business stakeholders, leadership, and vendors. Give short, regular updates on progress, risks, issues, and recommendations.
Quality and Operational Readiness: Support solution testing, non-functional requirements, release readiness, support model definition, and hand-off to operations.
Vendor and Partner Coordination: Work with vendors, partners, and internal teams to line up technical deliverables, clarify who owns what, remove blockers, and keep delivery joined up across the full solution.
Continuous Improvement: Look for ways to improve delivery practices, technical standards, documentation, reuse, automation, and how teams work together.
Artifacts: Accountable for the delivery of physical design diagrams and operational playbooks.

Experience and qualifications:

Post-secondary degree or diploma in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business Technology, or a related field preferred, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
8+ years in technology delivery, including leading technical work on complex projects or programs.
Good working knowledge of software delivery, systems integration, cloud, data, infrastructure, security, and operational support.
Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams without direct authority, including internal teams, vendors, and partners.
Experience turning business goals into technical plans, milestones, dependencies, risks, and decisions.
Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical topics clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Familiar with Agile, hybrid, and waterfall delivery, including sprint planning, release planning, cutover planning, and project governance.
Comfortable working through ambiguity, removing technical blockers, making practical recommendations, and getting people aligned.
Relevant certifications such as PMP, PMI-ACP, Scrum, SAFe, ITIL, cloud, architecture, or vendor/platform certifications are considered an asset.

title: Community Disability Worker (PT) - St Padro Pio
description:

This dynamic and challenging opportunity will allow you to develop and sharpen skills in behavior management, effective communication, and client focused strategies.
With our Agency, you will have the opportunity to work with individuals who have developmental disabilities, complex needs, and mental health diagnosis. In the capacity of Community Disability Worker, you will implement behavior support plans to help individuals learn coping and self-regulation skills, better enabling them to engage in a meaningful way with their peers, and their community.
Your ability to implement service plans, communicate with the members of your team in both writing and verbally, and a person centered approach, will help you to create effective relationships and work effectively as part of a team.
Your resourcefulness, creativity, and attention to detail, will help an individual shape their home into an environment that is safe for both them and those working with them, and that fosters relationship building and a sense of pride for those who live there.
Your ability to be innovative and aware of your environment will give you the skills to help individuals learn about and access opportunities to engage with their community in a way that is meaningful to them, and gives them a sense of joy. A high school diploma
A diploma or degree in Human Services or Social Work (or equivalent) is considered an asset
Experience with or willingness to be trained on physical holds on the individuals that we serve

A minimum 1 year working with persons with developmental disabilities, behavior, mental health & addictions

Child Intervention Record Check

The compensation for this position ranges from $19.37 to $20.56 per hour and is based on qualifications and experience.
Comprehensive benefit options when eligible.
Work within a highly collaborative, team-oriented organization, where your ideas are heard, and you can see your impact daily.
Growth Opportunities: apply and grow your skills within a dynamic, innovative and expanding Agency that is taking a leadership role in our industry.

About Catholic Social Services:
You will be joining an established Agency that is guided by faith to care for and bring hope to people in need with humility, compassion and respect.
With 65 years of service delivery experience, Catholic Social Services is one of the largest multi-function social services agencies in Canada, with nearly 2000 staff, and hundreds of volunteers delivering over 100 different programs to people in need throughout Central Alberta and Edmonton.
Our values are at the core of everything we do!

Humility: We acknowledge with gratitude our human abilities and limitations. We demonstrate humility by doing the best that we can with the resources that we have.
Compassion: We respond to people in need with love. We demonstrate our compassion by caring for people without judgment and without condition.
Respect: We demonstrate our respect by being personally present, open and attentive to those we care for and by honouring their dignity and freedom.

title: Patient Service Representative
description:
Metro Vein Centers is a rapidly growing healthcare practice specializing in state-of-the-art vein treatments. Our board-certified physicians and expert staff are on a mission to improve people’s quality of life by relieving the painful, yet highly treatable symptoms of vein disease—such as varicose veins and heavy, aching legs.

With over 70 clinics across 8 states, and still growing, we’re building the future of vein care—delivering compassionate, results-driven care in a modern, patient-first environment.

We proudly maintain a Net Promoter Score (NPS) of 93, the highest patient satisfaction in the industry.

About the Role

Metro Vein Centers is seeking a patient-focused Patient Service Representative (PSR) to support front desk operations in a fast-paced outpatient specialty clinic environment.

This is not a traditional receptionist role. Our PSRs are critical to the patient experience and clinic flow—supporting patient check-in and check-out, medical scheduling, insurance verification, payment collection, and front-office coordination throughout the day.

The ideal candidate thrives in a high-volume medical office environment, communicates professionally with patients and providers, and can confidently multitask between phones, scheduling, insurance verification, and in-person patient interaction.

Candidates with prior experience in medical front desk operations, healthcare scheduling, patient access, insurance verification, or outpatient clinic workflows are strongly encouraged to apply.

What Your Day Looks Like

  • Greeting and checking in patients throughout the day
  • Answering phones and assisting with appointment scheduling
  • Verifying insurance eligibility and collecting copays or balances
  • Managing EMR scheduling and patient documentation
  • Supporting clinic flow alongside providers and clinical staff
  • Assisting patients with billing questions, referrals, and appointment updates
  • Balancing multiple priorities in a fast-paced outpatient clinic environment

What You’ll Do

  • Greet and check in patients professionally both in person and over the phone
  • Verify insurance eligibility, benefits, and patient demographic information
  • Schedule, reschedule, and confirm patient appointments within the EMR system
  • Collect copays, coinsurance, balances, and required patient documentation
  • Answer patient questions related to scheduling, billing, referrals, and treatments
  • Maintain accurate patient records and scan required documentation into the EMR
  • Support clinic flow and communication between providers, patients, and clinical teams
  • De-escalate scheduling or patient concerns with professionalism and empathy
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and welcoming front desk environment

What You’ll Bring

  • Strong customer service and communication skills in a patient-facing environment
  • Ability to multitask between phones, scheduling, patient check-in, and administrative responsibilities
  • Comfort working in a fast-paced outpatient medical office or clinic setting
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy when handling patient information and scheduling
  • Professional demeanor with the ability to de-escalate patient concerns calmly and effectively
  • Comfortable using EMR systems, scheduling platforms, and healthcare technology
  • Team-oriented mindset with a proactive and dependable work style
  • Bilingual English/Spanish skills are strongly preferred

Education & Experience

  • High school diploma or equivalent required
  • 2+ years of customer service experience required
  • Prior experience in a medical front desk, healthcare scheduling, patient access, dental office, urgent care, specialty clinic, or outpatient healthcare setting strongly preferred
  • Experience with insurance verification, EMR scheduling, payment collection, or patient registration preferred

This Role Is Great For Candidates With Experience In:

  • Medical Front Desk
  • Patient Access
  • Healthcare Scheduling
  • Insurance Verification
  • Medical Reception
  • Outpatient Clinics
  • Dental Offices
  • Urgent Care
  • Specialty Medical Practices
  • EMR Scheduling
  • Medical Call Centers
  • Patient Registration

Language Skills

We welcome all applicants to apply. However, priority will be given to candidates who are bilingual in Spanish and English, as this skill helps us better serve our diverse patient population.

Full-time team members at Metro Vein Centers are eligible for:

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
  • 401(k) with Company Match
  • Paid Time Off (PTO) + Paid Company Holidays

  • Short-Term Disability Insurance
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Career Growth & Development Opportunities
  • Quarterly performance bonuses up to $1,500

Compensation

Competitive base compensation based on experience

The Metro Vein Centers Difference

Healthy legs. Happier lives.
At Metro Vein Centers, we believe exceptional care begins with an exceptional experience. Our mission is to make vein care approachable, empowering, and connected to overall well-being. From the first conversation to the final follow-up, every patient interaction reflects our commitment to compassion, expertise, and trust.

A team united by purpose.
Our values guide everything we do:

  • Patients First, Always – Every interaction should make our patients feel valued, heard, and cared for.
  • Stronger Together – Teamwork and collaboration drive our success. We lift each other up to deliver the best for our patients.
  • A Can-Do Spirit – We meet every challenge with positivity, flexibility, and problem-solving energy.

title: Maintenance Planner/Scheduler
description:
Founded in 1985, ATS is a company with a presence in the United States, Mexico and the United Kingdom. We are professionals in Industrial Maintenance and we make factories run better.

Fundada en 1985, ATS es una empresa con presencia en los Estados Unidos, México y el Reino Unido. Somos profesionales en mantenimiento industrial y hacemos que las fábricas funcionen mejor.

Principal Duties/Responsibilities:

· Evaluates non-emergency work requests, develops scope of work, and inspects job location to determine job requirements.

· Estimates labor hours, skillsets, parts, materials, equipment and special tools required to complete proactive jobs in a safe and efficient manner.

· Gathers relevant technical documentation such as drawings, schematics, specifications, spare parts lists from equipment histories, OEM manuals and the Knowledgebase system. Verifies the availability of parts prior to scheduling the job. Arrange for special tools and auxiliary equipment when required.

· Maintains an organized and prioritized work order backlog to determine the next highest priority jobs to be planned next and maintains the Ready Backlog at or above 80%.

· Employs the continuous improvement process to update Job Plans for accuracy and effectiveness.

· Conducts weekly planning & scheduling meetings with Production to determine work order priorities, communicate work order status and alter planned maintenance activities if necessary.

· Creates a Weekly Technician Schedule that includes priority planned jobs and preventative maintenance tasks that utilize 100% of the available technician labor hours.

· Improves work order planning and scheduling effectiveness through the review process and use of the maintenance metrics.

· Maintains records and files essential to meaningful analysis and reporting of maintenance related matters.

· Trains site employees on CMMS and ensures that it is working with integrity and is being utilized.

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities (KSAs), & Competencies:

Essential KSAs:

· Associate Degree required in a technical field with 1-3 years of maintenance scheduling / planning experience and/or 5 – 10 years as a machine repair technician, or equivalent combination of both

· Familiar with industrial manufacturing environment

· Electrical/mechanical aptitude

· Proficiency with computers, maintenance systems, and applications including Microsoft Office

· Excellent verbal communication, facilitation, and presentation skills

· Ability to build and maintain positive, professional relationships

Desirable KSAs:

· Desire to develop leadership attributes

· Experience in job plan development, job scheduling, and work execution

· Project management and capital project experience preferred

· CMRP certification

· Green Belt certification

· STS certification

Competencies:

· Drive & Motivation

· Interpersonal Skills

· Task Management

· Strategic Skills

· Customer Focus

Physical Demands and Working Conditions:

Position Title: LEARNING SPECIALIST

Department: Student Services

Reports To: Site Administrator and Director of Special Programs

JOB DEFINITION:

Under general supervision, the Learning Specialist serves as a teacher and case manager for students with special education needs who have an IEP. The Learning Specialist serves students with mild, moderate, and severe disabilities. The Learning Specialist works with a team of other Learning Specialist and educational assistants and serves students in a variety of settings from most restrictive to the least restrictive environment.

For students with mild/moderate disabilities, the Learning Specialist develops and implements program designed to provide a less restrictive alternative to the segregated special classroom. The Learning Specialist provides students with direct remedial instruction in academic subjects, cognitive processing, and appropriate social skills. In addition to these specific individualized programs, the Learning Specialist may push into the general education classroom and assist teachers with accommodations and/or modifications of curricula and the development of behavior management programs.

For student with severe disabilities, the Learning Specialist designs programs that provide for maximum teacher-student interaction in a highly structured environment. The program offers a variety of learning experiences which will help students gain the skills necessary for semi-independent or independent adult living, such as academics, communication skills, daily living skills, social skills and pre-vocational skills. Students who are enrolled in this program have an opportunity to apply the skills learned to real life situations in the community and on the job. Teachers, parents, and other specialists work cooperatively to prepare students for their transition to community living.

The Learning Specialist works under the supervision of the building principal and administrator in charge of the District's Student Services.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:

  • Performs case management responsibilities, meets district, state and federal requirements, including displaying knowledge of procedures, policies and regulations related to special education, follows corrective procedures, maintains proper and sufficient documentation, completes specialized student assessments and evaluations, confidentiality is a top priority for the person in this position.
  • Develops an Individual Education Program (IEP) in all areas of need as indicated by assessments and IEP team input.
  • Establish and facilitate meetings and discussions, including Identifies situations requiring group discussions, organizes and facilitates effective meetings, involving all participants, follows up and monitors any intended actions and outcomes.
  • Communicate, collaborate, and coordinate with outside agencies, including Plans for post-secondary transition and outcomes, works cooperatively with IEP team to prepare students for a transition to community living, provides informed and student directed opportunities in both school and community setting for vocational training.
  • Provides an individual learning program, which emphasizes development of language, social behavior, personal adequacy, physical fitness, health, and academic skills so competency in these areas can be attained.
  • Participates in school, district, and agency meetings.
  • Trains and coaches’ educational assistants, including; Creates their schedules, provides lesson plans for small group instruction and instructional guidance for general education setting, coaches and models systems and strategies to support students, provides data collection system for IEP progress monitoring, adjusts schedules to accommodate student needs, schedules ongoing meetings and trainings for EA’s, this may include coordinating with specialists. In addition, supervises safety, self-care, health care/delegated nursing procedures, personal hygiene care and mobility assistance services which can include lifting, restraining, feeding (spoon, gastronomy), and toileting/diapering supporting. Implements delegated occupational/physical therapy procedures.
  • Collaborate with General Education Teachers, including Communicate and collaborate consistently with teachers about individual student needs, articulate how the disability affects involvement and progress in general education curriculum, accommodations, modifications, supports to school personnel, all student’s will have access to general education opportunities, invite and articulate participation requirements at IEP meetings
  • Fulfills other duties as assigned.
  • Fulfills performance standards identified in the evaluation process as required by the position.
  • Fulfills working conditions and physical effort listed below.

WORKING CONDITIONS:

Work is performed primarily indoors in classroom or specialized instructional settings, with occasional outdoor supervision or participation in school activities. The position requires standing, walking, bending, kneeling, and assisting students with mobility, personal care, or physical regulation needs. The role may involve lifting, transferring, or supporting students and equipment consistent with assigned duties.

The employee may be exposed to escalated or challenging student behaviors and may encounter bodily fluids while supporting student needs. Participation in meetings, case management responsibilities, family communication, school events, conferences, professional responsibilities and activities outside the regular instructional day may be required, consistent with the Bend Education Association/Bend-La Pine Schools Collective Bargaining Agreement.

The role requires sustained concentration, documentation and compliance responsibilities, collaboration with service providers and families, and emotional regulation in high-needs situations. The employee must be able to perform the essential functions of the position with or without reasonable accommodation

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:

Knowledge:

  • Current concepts, methods and procedures for curriculum development and implementation.
  • Laws, rules, policies, and trends regarding instruction.
  • Techniques in evaluation and assessment of learning and human development.
  • Behavior management and communication techniques.
  • Understand differentiated instruction, this may include modified expectations, course content, extended instruction, adapted levels of curriculum, behavior intervention strategies and technology use.
  • Current technology, instructional knowledge and equipment used in the workplace, as required by the position.

Skills and Abilities:

Possess the physical ability to regularly attend work and fulfill the essential functions of the position, with or without reasonable accommodation.

  • Maintain a good working relationship with special programs and school personnel and to work effectively as a team member. Works well with others from diverse backgrounds. Focuses on solving conflicts; maintains confidentiality, listens to others; remains open to others’ ideas and contributes to building a positive team environment.
  • Demonstrates an ability to successfully work with students and public.
  • Learn the operation of current technology, and other equipment used in the work, as required by the position.
  • Adhere to the federal requirements of a drug-free workplace.
  • Perform the duties as required by the Teachers Standards and Practices Commission (OAR 584-20-000 to 035).
  • Ability to read fluently; communicate, understand, and carry out verbal and written instructions. Demonstrate basic mathematical functions.
  • Accurately record and convey information, materials and money, as required by the position.
  • Communicate clearly and appropriately in speech and in writing in accordance with educational standards.
  • Other certifications/trainings as required to execute the essential functions and duties and responsibilities for these positions (ie: bodily fluids, blood sugar testing, bee stings, dispensing of prescription medication)
  • Obtain or possess a valid Oregon driver's license and maintain an insurable status for automobile and liability coverage, as required by the position.
  • Complete all required special education forms and processes within specific timelines.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:

Holds a Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree

Background and experience with students with disabilities.

CERTIFICATION AND LICENSING:

Valid Oregon teaching license with special education endorsement in the designated assignment. Dual or multiple endorsements or designated as high qualified for core academic areas.

title: Sr. Materials Engineer (Starship)
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

SR. MATERIALS ENGINEER (STARSHIP)

Our Starship Materials Engineering team serves as experts in various materials disciplines for the broader company and works to make the best rockets and spacecraft in the world. As a member of this team, you will constantly improve the materials and processes that make Starship possible—from production through flight, maintenance, and reuse. This role applies materials engineering across the Starship program, developing and qualifying materials and processes for reliability in extreme environments on both new vehicles and those returning from flight.

You will apply special processing of metals—including plate, bar, and sheet processing, casting, forging, coatings, and heat treating—to the design, build, maintenance, and refurbishment of Starship hardware. If your goal is to make an impact at the cutting edge of materials and manufacturing technologies, this is the role for you.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Design, develop, and deploy materials and process direction for Starship design, manufacturing, maintenance, and refurbishment
  • Increase reliability of Starship manufacturing, maintenance, and reuse processes through material and process selection, analysis, development, and test
  • Develop physical, mechanical, and thermal properties for materials
  • Improve our special processes and materials through characterization and development
  • Work directly with component design build and test engineering, design reliability, and production teams daily
  • Perform root cause investigations using fractography, metallography, and testing
  • Provide technical reviews and advising for design efforts specifically related to drawings, specifications, and material requirements
  • Collaborate with other engineers, subject matter experts, and technicians to solve complex material and processing challenges on our current and next generation vehicles

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree in materials engineering or other engineering discipline with emphasis on materials
  • 5+ years of professional work experience in a materials engineering related role
  • Experience and expertise with multiple of the following manufacturing methods: tribological coatings (conversion, inorganic, dry-film lubricants), sheet/plate metal processing, casting, forging, brazing, welding, and heat treating

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Master's degree or PhD in materials engineering or related field
  • Tribological processes including, but not limited to evaluating and implementing protective coatings (polyurethane, urethane, conversion coating, inorganic coatings, dry-film lubricants, etc.) for internal and external environmental conditions including thermal wear, atmospheric, and space environments
  • Understanding of mechanical testing methods for metals including wear, tensile, fracture and fatigue
  • Experience with failure analysis and fractography including characterization techniques such as Fourier-transform infrared spectroscopy (FTIR), Scanning Electron Microscopy (SEM), and metallographic analysis
  • Knowledge of aerospace metals including nickel-based alloys, stainless steels, aluminum alloys, and titanium alloys
  • Knowledge of fluid and gas compatibility for various launch vehicle and spacecraft propulsion and fluid systems
  • Hands-on experience in a manufacturing environment
  • Understanding of non-destructive test methods for fracture and fatigue control
  • Maintain working knowledge of regulatory requirements, perform associated required tasks, and complete required documentation per SpaceX specifications and other external specifications such as NASA, OSHA, ASTM, NACE, ASME, AWS, ASM, etc.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Extended hours and weekend work may be required to support critical project and mission milestones
  • Up to 10% domestic travel is expected

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

  • To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

title: Amphinicy Technologies - Senior Cloud - Native Platform Engineer (Kubernetes & 5G Ntn)
description:
We are looking for a Senior Cloud-Native Platform Engineer to reinforce our team, which has more than two decades of experience in the satellite industry. You will contribute to the design, development, integration, and operation of the cloud-native orchestration, control, and operations layer for a next-generation 5G-Ntn ground-segment platform. This spans the orchestration and control plane (service and lifecycle orchestration, Mano-style, and SDN / cloud-native control), the OSS layer (inventory, service state, telemetry, and KPI monitoring), and a BSS layer (catalog and order workflows) that together turn the platform into a GateWay-as-a-Service product.

These are your responsabilities

  • You will be an integral part of an existing multidisciplinary team of experienced, friendly, and talented colleagues working across 5G, SATCOM, DSP, Virtualization, and system validation.
  • The work includes operating a cloud-based integration environment, integrating and packaging containerized 5G network functions, designing the Mano workflows that onboard, start, stop, reconfigure and roll back network functions and GateWay instances, building the OSS inventory and service state model exposed via northbound APIs, implementing telemetry collection and KPI computation, and delivering a minimal BSS layer (catalog, tenant/RBAC, order workflow) on top.
  • You will actively participate in a highly innovative project at the intersection of 5G, satellite communications, and cloud infrastructure, contributing to a real system demonstrator and not only to research studies.
  • You will help shape future ground-segment products and next-generation 5G-Ntn capabilities.

This is what you give

  • A BSc or MSc in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Telecommunications, or in a related field.
  • You bring with you an experience of at least 5 years in such role.
  • You have hands-on experience operating production-grade Kubernetes at scale with Infrastructure-as-code (e.g. TerraForm) and packaging/deployment (e.g. Helm).
  • You have strong Linux fundamentals and a solid networking knowledge.
  • Experience with container-based delivery (Docker / OCI) and CI/CD pipelines.
  • You possess a solid grasp of cloud-native architecture - MicroServices, northbound API design, observability, security and declarative / GitOps-style operations.
  • You are proficient in at least one programming language. We do not filter on a specific language - we care that you are productive in a modern backend/systems language and willing to work in ours.
  • You know how to debug complex distributed systems and work across software, networking, and infrastructure domains.
  • You communicate easily and enjoy working closely with software developers, product managers, 5G specialists, and validation engineers.
  • You are a fast learner, eager for new concepts and not afraid to apply them when challenged.
  • You work independently but know when to ask for help.
  • You produce clean, readable, well-structured documentation in good English.
  • You preferably hold a work permit for Luxembourg.
These are strong assets:
  • Knowledge of ETSI NFV concepts - Mano, Vnf/Cnf lifecycle management, and OSS/BSS architecture.
  • Hands-on experience with cloud-native 5G/Ntn orchestration, including open-source 5G stacks (Openairinterface, Free5gc, Open5gs, Ocudu, Aether, ONAP) and familiarity with O-RAN/SMO components such as the Near-/Non-RT Ric and the O1/O2 interfaces (e.g. SD-RAN).
  • Experience with SDN and programmable data planes - SDN control planes such as Μonos / Onos and SD-Fabric.

This is what you get

  • An attractive salary and relocation package.
  • A comprehensive training plan, starting with onboarding, which caters to your development needs and helps you achieve your career goals.
  • A supportive environment where people come first.
  • Flexible and partly remote working options.
  • An opportunity to work in a challenging fast-paced environment with the latest technologies which affect the lives of billions of people around the globe.
  • Work-life balance which includes an exciting lifestyle in the heart of Europe, in the multicultural city of Luxembourg.
This is us:
Amphinicy Technologies is a leading provider of complex software solutions for the space industry. We have been delivering solutions to the top players and organizations in the satellite and space industry for over 20 years, from our two offices in both Croatia and Luxembourg. Our engineers are leading experts in the domains of Satellite Communication and Earth Observation, and our unending focus is the perpetual improvement of the quality and efficiency of our state-of-the-art solutions in a creative, enjoyable, and supportive work environment.
This is your place of work:
Luxembourg is situated at the crossroads of Europe, between Germany, Belgium, and France. Despite its small size it sports a powerful economy with several well-paid and diverse job opportunities, and with long-term career prospects. A top-notch infrastructure, one of the best healthcare systems in Europe and a vibrant and multicultural lifestyle complete the puzzle of one of the best countries to live and work in.

title: Global Industry Lead, Healthcare
location: San Francisco; New York City; Seattle
description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Creating long-term value for our users is central to Stripe’s mission. The Go-to-Market (GTM) Industries team helps enterprise users and Stripe grow by understanding the challenges businesses face in specific industries and identifying how Stripe can help solve them.

We build Stripe’s expertise across key business verticals and develop the credibility and thought leadership needed to form relationships with industry leaders. In partnership with our GTM and Product teams, Industry Leads define relevant, value-focused solutions, support our users, and identify new sources of value for users and Stripe.

Our team provides industry expertise across Stripe and supports enterprise business development. We partner with enterprise users and large software-as-a-service (SaaS) platforms to address business challenges and help them grow with Stripe.

What you’ll do

As a member of the Global GTM Industries team, the Global Industry Lead for Healthcare will shape Stripe’s growth strategy across the healthcare ecosystem, including providers, payers, digital health companies, pharmacies, and healthcare platforms. You’ll use your industry expertise to define and communicate the value of Stripe’s solutions in a healthcare context and build credibility with senior executives and leaders across the industry.

You’ll partner with Sales, Marketing, Product Marketing, Partnerships, and Product teams to embed healthcare expertise across Stripe, support strategic deals, and develop our GTM strategy. You’ll also lead detailed product and business discussions with existing and prospective users.

Responsibilities

  • Shape Stripe’s GTM strategy for the next phase of growth in healthcare
  • Support account teams throughout the sales cycle, from identifying prospective enterprise users and developing pipeline through deal signing and activation
  • Build relationships with regional sales leaders and contribute to strategic account planning and user engagements
  • Develop executive-level narratives and presentations, lead detailed product discussions, and communicate Stripe’s value to senior decision-makers
  • Represent Stripe at industry events, community forums, and online events, offering a differentiated perspective on healthcare, regulatory, and technology trends
  • Create industry playbooks and lead enablement that helps sales teams understand the healthcare industry and engage users effectively
  • Partner with Product and Partnerships teams to share industry insights, shape relevant solutions, and build relationships with healthcare technology, implementation, and strategic partners

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

You have experience developing business strategy, supporting business development, and building GTM models. You understand the healthcare ecosystem and the challenges facing providers, payers, digital health companies, pharmacies, and healthcare platforms.

You can define solutions, communicate strategy and tactics, and work across functions and organizational levels. You’re comfortable engaging in business and technical conversations with users, internal stakeholders, and executives. You can build value in competitive situations, develop a detailed understanding of Stripe’s products, and share your expertise with others.

Minimum requirements

  • 12+ years of relevant experience in healthcare, healthcare technology, enterprise software, payments, consulting, or GTM roles, including substantial experience working with healthcare organizations
  • Experience identifying user needs and translating them into solutions and GTM strategies
  • Ability to understand complex technical requirements and develop solutions that address the needs of multiple stakeholders
  • Clear written, verbal, and presentation skills, including experience communicating complex ideas to executives and building collaborative relationships across functions
  • Ability to travel approximately 25% of the time for industry events, Stripe events, and key user meetings

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience with payments or enterprise software
  • Direct or indirect sales experience, including closing new business or expanding existing relationships
  • Experience advising enterprise organizations on growth, strategy, or GTM challenges
  • Experience building or growing an industry-focused team or program
  • Experience in an industry strategy or industry leadership role

title: Lead Motor Engineer
description:
The Lead Motor Systems Engineer is Klein Tools' primary technical authority for high-current brushless DC (BLDC) and related DC motor-drive systems used in lithium-ion battery-powered products. Based in Ningbo, China, this individual leads motor hardware, power electronics, embedded control, system integration, validation, supplier development, and production readiness for global programs. The role works independently through cross-functional teams and has no direct reports. This position joins a long-standing American brand during rapid growth in China and will help establish a permanent engineering team in China that delivers safe, efficient, production-ready solutions globally.

1. Lead architecture and technical direction for high-current BLDC and DC motor-drive systems.
2. Define torque, speed, position, power, efficiency, thermal, acoustic, duty cycle, and life targets.
3. Integrate motors with lithium-ion batteries, embedded controls, gearing, and mechanical loads.
4. Select and optimize BLDC, brushed DC, and permanent-magnet synchronous motor architectures.
5. Evaluate winding topology, turns, wire gauge, resistance, inductance, pole count, back-EMF, Kt, and Kv.
6. Develop and tune six-step commutation, FOC, SVPWM, and current, torque, speed, or position loops.
7. Develop or direct embedded C/C++ firmware using STM32, Arm, DSP, or similar motor-control platforms.
8. Design and validate three-phase inverters, MOSFET stages, gate drivers, sensing, PWM, and PCB layouts.
9. Define protection for overcurrent, short circuit, shoot-through, voltage faults, heat, stall, and locked rotor.
10. Build prototype controller boards, inverter stages, sensing circuits, and test fixtures.
11. Lead controller and inverter bring-up, debugging, characterization, and design validation.

Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Mechanical, Electromechanical, Mechatronics, or a related engineering field, with eight (8) or more years of relevant experience.

title: Store Assortment Planner
description:
Tecovas was founded with the simple goal of making the world's best western boots, apparel and leather goods - and selling them at a fair price. We are a brand revolutionizing a category and welcoming first-time boot buyers and western enthusiasts alike.

Tecovas is looking for a Store Assortment Planner to help get the right assortment into every one of our stores. This role is part of our Planning & Allocation team, built to give each store an assortment that fits its space, its customer, and its potential. You'll build and execute store-level assortments across the entire line, from pre-season capacity and choice count planning through in-season reviews and adjustments, and bring recommendations backed by data to the team. Reporting directly to the Senior Manager, Allocation, you'll partner closely with Merchandise Planning, Merchandising, Visual Merchandising, and Retail Operations, to grow the function as it expands from store assortments today to department and class planning at the store level tomorrow.

This role is required to be based in Austin, TX. Candidates must either be currently located in or willing to relocate to Austin, TX.

What you’ll do:

Pre-Season Store Assortment Planning

  • Build and maintain store-level assortment plans for the entire line, including boots, apparel, and accessories
  • Prepare pre-season store capacity plans that translate fixtures and square footage into the right number of choices for each store
  • Recommend choice count (CC) targets and door counts each season, including the stores we plan to open, and execute assortments against the approved plan

Door & Format Planning

  • Recommend the store groups and clusters to develop each season, and prepare clear handoffs to partners ahead of the season
  • Build and execute assortments for our small-concept stores (under 2,500 sq ft), making a tighter footprint feel just as complete
  • Support assortment planning for our shop-in-shop (SIS) partner locations, executing door-level plans and recommending adjustments

In-Season Assortment Management

  • Monitor assortments door by door through the season, recommending and executing adjustments as performance, inventory, and store feedback evolve
  • Turn assortment decisions from NPD checks, NSO reviews, and store checks into accurate updates in Invent.ai, our allocation and replenishment platform

Space, Floor & Store Partnership

  • Partner with Visual Merchandising on space and floor planning so product placement and assortment decisions work together
  • Conduct store reviews, including New Store Opening (NSO) reviews about 45 days after opening and an annual review of select stores, and recommend assortment changes based on what you find
  • Conduct regular store checks to see how assortments are landing in practice, and bring field feedback back into the plan

Experience we’re looking for:

  • 2-4 years of experience in Retail Planning, Assortment Planning, Allocation, or Merchandising; exposure to store-level or multi-door planning is a plus
  • Retail experience; time spent working in stores or partnering with the field is a plus
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Merchandising, or a related field
  • Strong analytical skills in Excel and AI tools
  • Familiarity with capacity planning, store clustering, and productivity metrics
  • Experience partnering cross-functionally and presenting recommendations to stakeholders
  • Ability to manage multiple timelines and recurring processes at once
  • Clear and effective communication skills, written and verbal

What you bring to the table:

  • A strategic mindset paired with a love for the details: you can see how the fleet fits together and still check a single store's fixture count
  • Patience and perspective. Assortment decisions take time to read, and you know how to let results develop before reacting
  • A growth-oriented mentality: you ask questions, seek feedback, and are excited to help build a new function and grow with it
  • A collaborative spirit. You enjoy working cross-functionally, value perspectives from the merchants and the field, and know that clear is kind

Full Time Benefits & Perks:

  • We offer insurance plans that pay 79-90% of your health premium coverage and 100% of your dental & vision insurance coverage for your family/dependents
  • 401(k) match
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Flexible PTO policy
  • Corporate wellness program
  • Competitive salary - $80,000-90,000/annum (commensurate with experience)
  • Eligibility to participate in Corporate Bonus Program
  • Generous employee discounts!

About Us:

Based in Austin, TX, Tecovas brings the spirit of the West to the modern consumer. Handcrafting the best Western footwear, workwear, apparel, and accessories, Tecovas has grown rapidly since its founding as the first digitally native Western brand in 2015, serving customers through , Tecovas Stores from coast to coast, and select wholesale partners. We’re certainly growing- and hiring passionate, humble, positive, and talented people determined to help us continue to grow!

Important note: We strive to hire values-aligned people because we believe it takes each and all of us to be successful, and lead with grit, speed and a clear vision of where we’re headed. title: Product Development Simulation Intern
description:
Job Summary
The Product Development Simulation Intern will work alongside experienced engineers to evaluate the structural performance of existing product designs using Finite Element Analysis (FEA), engineering calculations, and laboratory testing. The Product Development Simulation Intern will gain hands-on experience testing and analyzing injection molded plastic components used in demanding automotive, industrial, and consumer applications. This internship focuses on the critical relationship between physical testing and computer simulation, helping ensure that engineering analysis accurately predicts product performance. Working alongside Simulation and Validation engineers, you will design and conduct physical tests, collect performance data, and perform correlation studies that compare laboratory results with Finite Element Analysis (FEA) predictions. Your work will directly influence how products are tested, analyzed, and validated. This will be achieved while maintaining HellermannTyton's Quality and EHS certifications by supporting all corporate policies, procedures, work instructions, and required documentation.
Essential Functions

Support structural analysis activities for injection molded plastic components and assemblies that replicate physical testing. Testing could be static or dynamic (vibration).
Design, build, and execute mechanical tests on injection molded plastic components and assemblies.
Develop test setups and fixturing to accurately represent real-world loading conditions.
Collect and analyze measurements including load, displacement, strain, deformation, and failure data.
Create, run, and interpret finite element simulations using commercial FEA software.
Apply principles from Strength of Materials to evaluate stresses, strains, deflections, and factors of safety.
Perform correlation studies comparing physical test results to finite element simulation predictions.
Work directly with simulation engineers to improve modeling assumptions and analysis accuracy.
Help identify efficient testing strategies that provide reliable validation while minimizing cost and testing time.
Analyze the impact of material properties, loading conditions, and environmental factors on product performance.
Collaborate with design and testing teams to optimize analysis and testing functions.
Document engineering findings and present to technical teams.

Success in this role will require

Experience with ANSYS, Abaqus, SOLIDWORKS Simulation, HyperWorks, or similar FEA software
CAD experience using SOLIDWORKS, Creo, CATIA, NX, or similar platforms
Understanding of plastic material behavior and manufacturing processes
Experience with engineering laboratory testing or data analysis
Familiarity with MATLAB, Python, or other engineering analysis tools

What You'll Bring

Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Aerospace, Materials Engineering, Engineering Mechanics or a related engineering discipline.
Junior or Senior standing
Successful completion of Strength of Materials (Mechanics of Materials) or Engineering Mechanics/Statics
Exposure to Finite Element Analysis through coursework, projects, research, or internships
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Ability to communicate technical information effectively

description:
Dive in and do the best work of your career at DigitalOcean. Journey alongside a strong community of top talent who are relentless in their drive to build the simplest scalable cloud. We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer II to join our Managed Databases (DBaaS) engineering organization. Managed Databases delivers fully managed Postgres, MySQL, and related database services so customers can run production data workloads—and increasingly AI inference and data-intensive applications—without operating clusters themselves.

In this high-impact IC4 role, you will apply advanced subject-matter expertise across distributed control planes, database platform infrastructure, and production reliability. You will bridge product and system requirements with concrete architecture, lead complex technical projects across DBaaS and adjacent platform boundaries (e.g., Networking, Droplets, Storage, engine teams), and mentor engineers to elevate standards on the team. You should be comfortable independently moving from ambiguous problems to design, implementation, launch, and long-term operation.

What You’ll Do

  • Architect and implement DBaaS platform systems: Design and build scalable control-plane and infrastructure components that improve throughput, multi-region operability, and reliability for managed database workloads.
  • Turn ambiguous requirements into deliverable architecture: Deconstruct customer and system needs into clear technical designs and workstreams that drive predictable delivery with product and engineering partners.
  • Own performance and resiliency outcomes on your services: Improve resource utilization, fault tolerance, and availability—using profiling and targeted changes against I/O, CPU, and network bottlenecks under real production load.
  • Strengthen lifecycle capabilities: Ship improvements to automated failover, continuous backups, point-in-time recovery (PITR), and maintenance workflows so clusters handle higher data volumes and tighter SLAs.
  • Scale for data-heavy and AI-adjacent demand: Expand and harden control-plane and infrastructure pieces that support compute-heavy and high-concurrency customer workloads.
  • Raise the team engineering bar: Guide technical decisions for engineers on the squad through design and code reviews; contribute clear design docs for the initiatives you lead.
  • Mentor team members: Coach engineers through technical guidance, architectural reviews, and code-quality standards to accelerate growth and execution velocity.
  • Operate what you build: Establish observability, failover, and recovery practices; participate in on-call; turn incident learnings into durable platform improvements.

What You’ll Bring

  • Experience: 8+ years of professional software engineering experience building and operating large-scale distributed systems or data-plane/control-plane infrastructure (SaaS/PaaS or equivalent).
  • Production depth: Proven track record diagnosing and solving complex, high-concurrency engineering problems in production cloud environments.
  • Database platform fluency: Working knowledge of relational database engine internals—specifically PostgreSQL and/or MySQL—including query performance, replication, and scale (preferred).
  • Distributed systems mastery: Strong understanding of concurrency, failure modes, multi-region concerns, and performance optimization in production Linux/cloud environments.
  • Scale for data & AI workloads: Experience scaling services for compute, memory, and networking demands of data-intensive or AI inference-adjacent workloads (preferred).
  • Collaboration & mentorship: Track record of driving complex cross-team technical projects, mentoring engineers, and communicating tradeoffs clearly with partners and leadership.
  • Growth mindset: Appetite for feedback and a “leave it better than you found it” approach to architecture and maintainability.
